subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu gain a supported attachment-content opt-out, and what canonical config shape should own it?
rationale: The reported key is absent from current and reported-release schema/docs, so accepting it would add new Feishu channel policy rather than fix a documented shipped setting.

options.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented top-level and per-account Feishu option that defaults to current downloads and switches inbound files to placeholder-only context when enabled.

options.title: Use Shared Media Policy
options.body: Design a cross-channel attachment-ingestion shape so Feishu aligns with existing Signal and iMessage attachment controls instead of adding another one-off name.

options.title: Document Unsupported Key
options.body: Clarify that Feishu currently supports media size limits but not file-content ignore behavior, leaving attachment downloads as the intended behavior.

recommendation.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented top-level and per-account Feishu option that defaults to current downloads and switches inbound files to placeholder-only context when enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman has the clearest recent Feishu media/docs history from PR 47968, which touched the same media and documentation surface.
